usageNotes: Use this to update an existing PDM remote's configuration — credentials, cluster node addresses, auth token, or web URL — without recreating it. Requires the `Resource.Modify` privilege on the specific remote resource. Pass the `digest` field (from a prior GET) to guard against concurrent modifications overwriting each other; if the stored digest differs from what you submit, the update is rejected.

examples.summary: Rotate the API token secret for a managed PVE remote

tips: The `delete` array lets you unset optional properties (e.g. `web-url`) without touching the rest of the config.
Remote IDs are 2–32 characters and must match the pattern [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*; plan the ID at creation time since renaming requires delete-and-recreate.
Returns null on success — a 200 with no body is the expected response; treat any non-2xx as a failure.
The `nodes` array should list the Proxmox cluster node addresses that this remote exposes; keeping it accurate ensures PDM can reach the correct endpoints.
